CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-tick-relay-decouple, at head 0cc148b2f80fe224ffe2c504b29fd4f0908183df. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 0cc148b2f80fe224ffe2c504b29fd4f0908183df for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-tick-relay-decouple, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-tick-relay-decouple <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-tick-relay-decouple; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
tools/audit/seat/tick_loop.sh runs cloud_relay.sh pass and orchestrator_tick.py serially each pass, so a relay pass that runs update_pr.sh (a full app_push.sh prepr, measured 27+ min on 2026-10-21 for #2525) leaves the tick board unwritten that whole time (tick.txt stale 66+ min while the loop was alive). Fix so the board is written every interval regardless of the relay: e.g. the relay pass runs as its own bounded or detached child with a lock so passes never overlap, and the tick still runs each interval; the TICK-PASS line reports relay=running when one is in flight. Never kill an update_pr mid-push. Self-test (tick_loop.sh --self-test, already wired) gains an arm: a stub relay that sleeps longer than the interval must not delay the tick write; demonstrate it failing on the current loop and passing on the fix, plus a null control with a fast relay. Cite R10-TICK-OWED-LEVEL and R10-RCA-ORCH-CONTINUITY; do not redo them. Run prepr with PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1 (tvofi 2026-10-21).
